claims.claim: Testing escalated from culture to low-throughput PCR to high-throughput PCR, with turnaround falling from 82.1 to 37.6 to 20.3 hours.
The outbreak involved 29 colonized patients and no associated clinical infections.
Room/environmental pathways were important; 50% of secondary transmission was attributed to rooms previously occupied by colonized patients.
Outbreak sequencing showed a highly clonal Clade I cluster.
Causal attribution to any single intervention is not possible because interventions were concurrent.
